title: Evolving Federated Density Peak Clustering with Shuffler-Based Anonymization
abstract: arXiv:2610.31211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we present a novel one-shot federated clustering approach based on evolving fuzzy clustering and shuffler-based anonymization. In federated clustering, each round reveals additional model information to the server and can increase the opportunity to infer properties of local datasets, even when raw samples are never shared. Consequently, fewer client-server exchanges and unlinkability are important, so transmitted information cannot be attributed to any single client. Data-stream clustering algorithms, which learn in a single pass over the data, align well with the one-shot federated learning paradigm, where a single communication round can be sufficient. The proposed Evolving Federated Density Peak Clustering (eFDPC) method combines evolving fuzzy data-stream clustering and density peak clustering in a federated setting. translated_title: 基于混洗器匿名化的演化联邦密度峰值聚类
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种基于演化模糊聚类与混洗器匿名化的新型单次联邦聚类方法。在联邦聚类中，每一轮通信都会向服务器泄露额外的模型信息，即使原始样本从未被共享，也可能增加推断本地数据集属性的机会。因此，减少客户端与服务器之间的交换次数以及实现不可链接性至关重要，即传输的信息不能被归因于任何单个客户端。数据流聚类算法通过对数据进行单次遍历即可完成学习，这与单次联邦学习范式高度契合——在该范式下，仅需一轮通信即可完成任务。所提出的演化联邦密度峰值聚类方法在联邦环境中融合了演化模糊数据流聚类与密度峰值聚类。每个客户端通过聚类添加机制，从私有的数据小批量样本中独立演化微簇。
tldr: 该论文提出了eFDPC方法，将演化模糊数据流聚类与密度峰值聚类相结合，并借助混洗器匿名化技术，在仅一轮通信的单次联邦学习范式中实现聚类，同时保证客户端数据的不可链接性与隐私安全。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes eFDPC, a one-shot federated clustering method that combines evolving fuzzy data-stream clustering with density peak clustering, using shuffler-based anonymization to ensure client unlinkability and privacy with a single communication round.
